Here is a complete report of the Memo entity/model definition at each layer of the codebase.

---

## 1. SQL Schema

The memo table is defined in the `LATEST.sql` migration files for all three supported databases:

- **SQLite**: `/bench/repo/store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (line 33)
- **PostgreSQL**: `/bench/repo/store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` (line 32)
- **MySQL**: `/bench/repo/store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` (line 32)

All three define the same columns (with minor dialect differences):

| Column       | SQLite type     | Postgres type | MySQL type     |
|--------------|-----------------|---------------|----------------|
| `id`         | INTEGER PK AUTO | SERIAL PK     | INT AUTO PK    |
| `uid`        | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL UNIQUE |
| `creator_id` | INTEGER NOT NULL | INTEGER NOT NULL | INT NOT NULL |
| `created_ts` | BIGINT (epoch)  | BIGINT (epoch) | TIMESTAMP      |
| `updated_ts` | BIGINT (epoch)  | BIGINT (epoch) | TIMESTAMP      |
| `row_status` | TEXT (CHECK)    | TEXT           | VARCHAR(256)   |
| `content`    | TEXT            | TEXT           | TEXT           |
| `visibility` | TEXT (CHECK)    | TEXT           | VARCHAR(256)   |
| `pinned`     | INTEGER (0/1)   | BOOLEAN        | BOOLEAN        |
| `payload`    | TEXT (JSON)     | JSONB          | JSON           |

---

## 2. Go Store Model

**File**: `/bench/repo/store/memo.go` (line 35)

```go
type Memo struct {
    ID         int32
    UID        string
    RowStatus  RowStatus
    CreatorID  int32
    CreatedTs  int64
    UpdatedTs  int64
    Content    string
    Visibility Visibility
    Pinned     bool
    Payload    *storepb.MemoPayload
    ParentUID  *string        // composed field, not in DB directly
}
```

This is the core domain struct used in the store layer (not generated from protobuf). It also defines companion types `FindMemo` (line 57) and `Visibility` (line 13) in the same file.
